inputs: company/delegation_policy.yaml: seats, grants, budget ladder, autonomy map
company/org_registry.yaml and company/permissions.yaml, supplied by the caller
One AuthorityRequest: action, requesting seat, department, risk, optional amount
An ExceptionContext the caller fills from the job, review and gate it already holds
invariants: Shadow only: every decision and record refuses to claim authority to act, and mode=enforcing is refused at construction.
The reserved set is read from company/permissions.yaml, never restated; a grant naming a reserved action is refused at load.
Changing the delegation policy, expanding authority, changing governance and an unclassified action are reserved unconditionally.
A seat never decides a request it raised, and self-approval is checked before any ceiling.
Escalation stops at the lowest sufficient seat; a dormant, restricted or vacant seat decides nothing.
A subordinate grant may not exceed its escalation target on risk or on budget.
An unknown budget ceiling escalates rather than counting as unlimited; sibling ceilings may not sum past their parent.
Each objective records its parent intent digest, so an edited CEO objective orphans its decompositions.
outputs: An AuthorityDecision: APPROVED, REJECTED or ESCALATE, with the chain it walked
An ExceptionReport naming why the CEO has to see this, empty for routine success
An ExecutiveDecisionRecord, appended and never rewritten
An ExecutiveBrief: outcome, cost against budget, decisions held internally, escalations
A ShadowReport proving the canonical CEO stop semantics still hold
purpose: Calculates, in shadow, which seat would be competent to approve an action, where it escalates, which management exceptions the CEO must see, and how an objective decomposes inside a planning envelope. It authorizes nothing.
risks: Three registry employees are active, so most paths collapse onto studio_coo and chief_architect.
The cfo and engineering_manager seats are vacant because hiring an executive is CEO-reserved.
approve_deployment is granted to no seat and reserved by nobody: there is no deployment policy yet.
Historical scenarios are transcribed from reports on other branches, not read from a state directory.
title: Company executive delegation (shadow)
